changelog:
- Renamed and refocused skill from message-hub to ima-team-board, now utilizing Tencent IMA API for asynchronous team collaboration.
- Removed hub_client.py and message_hub.py; added ima_board.py as the new core implementation file.

summary: IMA Team Board - AI Team Collaboration Message Board via IMA API
